inspection: Static source bytes and retained JSON/gzip only; no native module imported or executed.
producer: NativeSrcBridge.run, not an unrelated total_ms producer. NativeCompositionAuthority.bridge uses its default unmodified performance.now clock.
creationRule: A new lastRelease must match a unique source-persisted src_decision body from the same handle before total_ms is added; its release note must name a newly validated role chain. Duration must be finite, nonnegative and no greater than both captured containing intervals.
retentionRule: The whole report and release note are byte-value-identical to creation on subsequent advance/inspect points, including total_ms.
limit: The bridge internal start/end timestamps were not separately captured; creation duration is bounded, not recomputed. No decision field other than the exact /whyAct/decision/total_ms leaf gets a new inter-role attribution.
